# Estuary quality jobs

The planner expands requested roots to their prerequisites. A shared prerequisite is scheduled once. src/estuary/cli.py owns the morning request.

turns.prompt: Repository: estuary-quality-jobs. Inspect the project in /app read-only. Do not modify or create files, install dependencies, or start services. How many distinct job names are returned by morning_plan()? Follow recursive prerequisites and deduplication, rather than counting all registered graph entries. Return the count.
